title: AP EAPCET / JEE Rank Card & Hall Ticket (2025/2026)
desc: Download 4 copies from official APSCHE cets.apsche.ap.gov.in or NTA portal.

title: SSC / 10th Class Marks Memo (Date of Birth Proof)
desc: Original certificate + 3 xerox sets for age and name verification.

title: Intermediate (10+2 MPC) Marks Memo-cum-Pass Certificate
desc: Issued by BIEAP / CBSE / ICSE showing PCM aggregate marks.

title: Study Certificates from Class 6th to Intermediate (7 Years)
desc: Mandatory to establish your 85% Local Area (AU or SVU region) eligibility.

title: Transfer Certificate (TC) from Junior College
desc: Original TC must be submitted at the allotted engineering college.

title: Latest Income Certificate (< ₹2.5L) or White Ration / Rice Card
desc: Issued on/after Jan 1st from Grama/Ward Sachivalayam for 100% JVD Fee Reimbursement.

title: Integrated Caste Certificate (SC / ST / BC-A/B/C/D/E) or EWS Certificate
desc: Issued by Tahsildar / MeeSeva with verifiable barcode for reservation scaling.

title: Residence / Local Status Certificate (If Private Study)
desc: Required only for candidates who studied privately or migrated from Telangana.

title: Student & Mother Aadhaar Card + NPCI Bank Account Link
desc: Active bank account linked with Aadhaar for JVD & Vasathi Deevena direct credit.
